step: P9, cartridges and the preference layer, first form
read_by: nmlearn::cartridge::Policy::load (values below; the code holds the same values as its stated fallback) and nmlearn::preference

fields.id: unique id; a learning unit keeps its registry id
fields.kind: learning-unit, encoded-cache or other; muscle-memory-pack is refused (muscle memory is its own store, guide 5.3)
fields.data_class: sensory or behavioural (guide 5.1); never mixed in one active set
fields.base: base population name, the folder under weights/
fields.base_sha256: SHA-256 of the released base weights it fits (weights/<base>/part.json field weights.sha256)
fields.components: component nodes or layers covered; each must be loaded for the slot check to pass
fields.scopes: scope keys role:kind:repo it serves; a missing or * segment matches any
fields.version: 1 plus the length of its lineage
fields.check: Step Check result, one of check_results
fields.loaded: whether it is plugged in now

label.unit_data_class_reason: learning units learn judgments only (ranking, compression, withhold, breakage prediction, routing; rules.md), which control behaviour; they hold no sensory content

stacking.composition: select per request and arbitrate at the output; parameters are never merged
stacking.max_active_source: rules.md: a cap of 16 active units
stacking.reliability: Beta posterior of the cartridge's recorded track record, interval mean plus or minus z standard deviations, lower bound scaled by the answer's own confidence
stacking.z_source: one-sided level 0.05, the same level as the readout sign test (nmlearn::readout::ALPHA)
stacking.bar: the base path's recorded success rate in the slot, from units/outcomes.jsonl (derived at run time)
stacking.fallback_threshold_use: only when no outcome is recorded in the slot

outcomes.re-read: neither answer reliable, or the two answers score different candidate sets
outcomes.combine: same top candidate, or both reliable with overlapping intervals: scores weighted by confidence over variance
outcomes.controls: different top candidates and only one reliable, or one's lower bound above the other's upper bound

preferences.rule: deterministic diff of the preferred and the other form: prefer = terms only in the preferred form, avoid = terms only in the other
preferences.recall_k: ceil(sqrt(number of records)), derived at run time
preferences.embedder: the exact hashed embedder of the Core Brain (nmbrain::slot::embed) behind the Embedder trait
preferences.pairwise_head: later, once enough pairs exist (number from the leave-one-out curve)
